news.title: STAT+: Cytokinetics details trial win for what could be its next approval
news.summary: It took Cytokinetics 27 years to win its first drug approval. With the results of a new trial, its second could come much faster.

news.title: STAT+: In autopsy of failed heart disease study, AstraZeneca raises broader questions about silencer drugs
news.summary: AstraZeneca detailed the surprise failure of a closely watched heart disease trial, a study with ripple effects for a competitive billion-dollar market.

news.summary: Comments about vaccines overshadowed an advisory committee meeting to discuss a plan for boosting federal funding for autism research.

news.summary: Primary care is much more than what happens during an office visit, writes physician Ishani Ganguli.

news.summary: How disease spreads and the risks and benefits of interventions are questions for science, not for ideology.

news.title: STAT+: FDA approves Roivant therapy for rare autoimmune disease
news.summary: The FDA approved a new medicine from Roivant and its subsidiary Priovant for the treatment of dermatomyositis, a rare autoimmune disease.

news.title: STAT+: Former Stanford president releases emails to rebut fraud and cover-up allegations in new book
news.summary: Marc Tessier-Lavigne released new details from his research and travel in an attempt to refute allegations in a new book that he published fraudulent results.

news.title: STAT+: CMS plans launch event for ACCESS, the Medicare chronic care pilot
news.summary: In this edition of STAT Health Tech: CMS plans a launch event for Medicare chronic care pilot, and what the Meta settlement means for health AI.

news.summary: Hospital prep a lobbying push, RFK Jr. faces more bad news on measles, and the cancer drug that helped Ben Sasse gets approved.

news.summary: A heart drug failure, RevMed's pancreatic cancer drug approved, and more biotech news from The Readout

news.summary: Health secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. said a Samoa trip had nothing to do with vaccines. New documents obtained by The Associated Press and The Guardian refute that testimony.

news.summary: RFK Jr. downplays measles threat, FDA approves pancreatic drug, and more health news from Morning Rounds

news.title: STAT+: Cassidy criticizes FDA oversight of abortion pill manufacturers in new report
news.summary: The report raises a high-profile issue for Heidi Overton as she faces confirmation as FDA commissioner.

news.title: STAT+: Alnylam’s heart drug troubles take center stage at a cardiology conference
news.summary: The European Society of Cardiology Congress that kicks off Friday in Munich will be a consequential meeting for Alnylam Pharmaceuticals.

news.title: Corewell Health unveils $1.7B plan to build 2 new hospital towers
news.summary: The Michigan nonprofit system is targeting 2030 for new builds at its Grand Rapids and Troy hospital campuses.

news.title: Eli Lilly study aims to bolster case for long-term Zepbound benefits
news.summary: As Medicare's GLP-1 Bridge program gets underway in earnest and questions remain about the long-term use of these drugs, Eli Lilly is offering a new look at how older adults fare on its medication, Zepbound.

news.title: The Villages Health reaches $541M False Claims Act settlement with DOJ
news.summary: The Villages Health System has agreed to a $541.5 million settlement to resolve allegations that it submitted false diagnosis codes to secure higher payouts in Medicare Advantage.

news.title: PhRMA's Medicare price negotiation suit rebuffed in latest blow to industry IRA challenge
news.summary: In the latest in a string of setbacks in biopharma’s efforts to fight Medicare drug price negotiations, a lawsuit from the industry’s top lobbying group has been rejected at the appeals level.

news.title: Maven finds its high-risk pregnancies had lower NICU, C-section rates than national benchmarks
news.summary: The study looked at high-risk Maven members with hypertension or diabetes, compared to CDC data.

news.title: Fierce Healthcare Fundraising Tracker '26: Arintra lands $25M; Happy Health buoyed by $75M round
news.summary: Keep up with all the venture capital dollars being funneled into the health tech and digital health industries.

news.title: US Attorney's Office scandal yields favorable deal for ex-hospital CEO charged with embezzlement
news.summary: "You got lucky here," a federal judge told George Miller, who was CEO of Loretto Hospital from 2017 to 2022.

news.title: Cigna unveils new plan to bring together medical, supplemental benefits
news.summary: Cigna is looking to better link medical and supplemental benefits for its members and has unveiled a new employer benefit that aims to further that goal.

news.title: 53% of US adults feel they have no say when AI is used in care
news.summary: Alongside wanting more input on AI usage in healthcare, nearly half of respondents (46%) report being unsure whether the technology was even used in their care.

news.title: University of Houston launches interdisciplinary institute to guide local housing interventions
news.summary: The Institute for Housing, Homelessness and Health (IH3) will work alongside community orgs, hospitals, local government and housing providers to help the group scale successful approaches. Its focus will be on data integration.

news.title: Sword Health to acquire Headspace in all-cash deal
news.summary: The virtual physical therapy and mental health platforms are targeting a September close, per a regulatory filing. A price tag was not disclosed, but is being reported to land between $200 million and $300 million.

news.title: Transcarent launches bundled payment model for cancer therapies
news.summary: The model offers members potential savings of up to $150,000, executives say.

news.title: Genentech doubles down on ADC-resistant cancers with $1B DualityBio pact
news.summary: Roche’s Genentech is paying DualityBio $45 million upfront for rights to antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) designed for the growing pool of patients who progress after treatment with the modality. The deal is worth more than $1 billion in potential milestones.

news.title: Research into protein interactions sheds new light on causes of autism
news.summary: Studying protein-protein interactions might hold the key to identifying druggable targets for autism, a group of scientists at the University of California, San Francisco has suggested.

news.title: With mRNA back in the spotlight, tRNA shows potential to treat genetic disease
news.summary: New research coming out of the University of Toronto has shown that transfer RNA may offer a promising therapeutic avenue for treating genetic diseases.

news.title: CEPI backs push to bring Egyptian biotech's Ebola vaccine into clinic to curb fast-growing outbreak
news.summary: The Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations has committed up to $16.5 million to push Minapharm’s Bundibugyo vaccine candidate into the clinic, furthering its response to the Ebola outbreak.

news.title: Osivax bags flu vaccine rights to pursue combination shot vision
news.summary: Osivax has licensed an influenza vaccine from GC Biopharma, positioning the biotech to build on early evidence that its midphase candidate complements traditional flu shots.

news.title: After some ‘tough years,’ Frontier’s CEO is ramping up ambitions for precision med platform
news.summary: After announcing the “tough but necessary” decision to lay off some employees last year, Frontier Medicines is looking to the future by advancing more cancer drugs into the clinic while continuing to find partners to leverage its AI proteomic platform.

news.title: Roche nabs expanded FDA approval for diagnostic tied to Jazz’s cancer drug
news.summary: Roche has been given an extended clearance by the FDA for its tests that can find patients eligible to use Jazz Pharmaceuticals’ oncology med Ziihera.

news.title: Flagship’s ProFound partners with Gates Foundation in $35M preeclampsia target discovery pact
news.summary: Flagship Pioneering’s ProFound Therapeutics is keeping its string of high-profile partnerships going, forging a new pact with the Gates Foundation worth up to $35 million to find new drug targets for a dangerous pregnancy complication.

news.title: Medigen links up with Charles River in push to take enterovirus vaccine global
news.summary: Charles River Laboratories and Taiwan-based Medigen Vaccine Biologics are teaming up to advance Medigen’s multivalent enterovirus vaccine.

news.title: FDA greenlights Revolution Medicines' pancreatic cancer gamechanger
news.summary: Following dynamite data that earned a standing ovation at the American Society of Clinical Oncology meeting in May, Revolution Medicines’ Ras inhibitor daraxonrasib has been approved by the FDA for the treatment of metastatic pancreatic cancer.

news.title: Akeso CEO looks beyond lung cancer with biliary tract win, counters ivonescimab debate
news.summary: Fresh off a phase 3 win in biliary tract cancer, Akeso CEO Michelle Xia, Ph.D., is touting the PD-1xVEGF bispecific antibody ivonescimab’s ability beyond non-small cell lung cancer, even as she continues to defend the drug’s data against skepticism.

news.title: JATT mastermind launches latest biotech-focused SPAC via $60M IPO
news.summary: Just two months after Someit Sidhu, M.D., succeeded in pairing off his second special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) with Talawar Therapeutics, the biotech entrepreneur is back at it again.

papers.title: Open-MOPD: Diagnosing and Fixing Capability Imbalance in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (M-OPD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for consolidating domain-specialized reinforcement learning (RL) experts into a single generalist student via dense, token-level reward supervision. Despite its practical success, the optimization dynamics governing multi-teacher capability integration remain poorly understood, and open, rigorously reproducible recipes are conspicuously lacking.
